movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Amnesia
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Magnitude
movelist.effect: When you use Magnitude, roll 1d6.  Magnitude’s Damage Base is equal to 5+X, where X is the value of the d6. Magnitude can hit targets that are underground, including those using the Move Dig.

movelist.name: Flame Burst
movelist.effect: Any Trainers or Pokémon cardinally adjacent to the target lose 5 Hit Points.

abilities.name: White Flame
abilities.effect: The user may not make rolls to cure themselves from the Enraged condition. However, while Enraged, the user gains a +5 Bonus to all Damage Rolls.

abilities.name: Solid Rock
abilities.effect: The user gains +5 Damage Reduction against Super- Effective damage. Defensive.
